RESULT [attribution]: The influence-predicted effect of a group correlates surprisingly well with its actual effect, even though absolute and relative errors are large. The correlation holds only under particular dataset properties, which they characterise theoretically.
US [attribution]: This supports batch or source granularity (one Kaggle/HF slug or one harvest increment) as the right unit for rollback attribution. Rankings such as 'which of the last 5 batches is most likely harmful' are more trustworthy than the size of the predicted mAP change. Use it to choose which batch to ablate first, then confirm with a seeded retrain.
